bio: Here, traditional Swabian cuisine meets global influences, blending local and international flavours. Enjoy cordial service in the comfort of either the main dining room steeped in history or the charming inner courtyard. The kitchen serves up seasonally influenced dishes. One of the most tempting dishes is the house classic: Swabian Zwiebelrostbraten (fried beef and onions in gravy) with maultaschen, spaetzle and salad. Chic guestrooms are available for overnight stays. On Tuesday evenings, the restaurant is only open to hotel patrons....
